title: brevipodium sylvaticum
intro: Brevipodium sylvaticum, commonly known as the Bearberry or Kinnikinnick, is a low-growing, evergreen shrub native to North America. This plant has been used in traditional medicine for its health benefits, which include treating urinary tract infections and improving digestion. The therapeutic actions of Brevipodium sylvaticum are attributed to its astringent and anti-inflammatory properties, which help to reduce swelling and soothe irritated tissues. The bioactive constituents of this plant include arbutin, which has been found to exhibit antimicrobial and antioxidant activities.
